title: Amazon Catalog & Listing Specialist (Flat Files), Premium & Heritage Brands
description:
We are an established Amazon agency (20+ years) managing premium and heritage brands in categories like tabletop, glassware, home, and gift. Many of these brands are older companies whose product data was built for retail, not for Amazon, so it arrives incomplete and messy. We are hiring an experienced catalog specialist to take that data and get it live, accurate, and fully indexed on Amazon at scale.

This role is a fit if you have several years of hands-on experience building and fixing Amazon listings through flat files across large catalogs, and you are current on how Amazon search and indexing work today. If your experience is editing listings one at a time in the Seller Central interface, and you have not worked with flat files at scale, this is not the right role for you.

What the role involves:



Taking brand product data and getting it live correctly: right category, right flat file template, valid values, titles, bullets, backend, images mapped

Bulk uploads and error triage across catalogs with thousands of SKUs

Diagnosing and fixing de-indexed, suppressed, and buy-box-suppressed listings

Verifying that backend changes actually propagate to the live listing, and resolving it when they do not

Keeping catalog and pricing data clean in SellerCloud

Reading and maintaining SOPs



Requirements:



Multiple years building and fixing Amazon listings via flat files, with real examples you can show

Strong command of category templates, valid values, bulk uploads, and error troubleshooting at scale

Current understanding of how Amazon search works now, including Rufus and Cosmo and semantic indexing

Experience with large or messy catalogs and incomplete source data is a major plus

Familiarity with tools such as Seller Central, FlatFile Pro, SellerCloud or a similar ERP, ChannelMax or other repricers, Helium 10, and Excel

Reliable, consistent daily hours with some overlap with US Eastern Time

ClickUp for tasks and time tracking (we will train you)



How to apply (we screen carefully, applications that skip these steps are not reviewed):



Start your subject line with the word TANGIER.

Answer these three questions in your own words, briefly and specifically. We are judging how you think, and generic or AI-written answers are easy to spot.



a. A listing has had zero impressions for a full month. What is the first thing you check, and why?



b. What are Rufus and Cosmo, and how have they changed the way you fill out a flat file? If you have not worked with them yet, say so, and tell me how you would get up to speed.



c. Describe one specific listing or catalog problem you fixed: what was wrong, how you found it, what you did, and the result. One short paragraph.



d. what are the latest Amazon Title guidelines and what does a good title like for a heritage brand?

 

Optional, but it helps: attach a flat file you have built or a screenshot of a bulk-upload error you resolved.

Include your CV.

title: Next.js + Supabase Developer — Build Web Apps From Complete Designs (Claude Code, AI-Assisted) — $8/hr to start
description:
Title: Next.js + Supabase Developer — Build Web Apps From Complete Designs (Claude Code, AI-Assisted) — $8/hr to start



I'm hiring one full-stack developer to build custom web applications for my US-based

business. This is real, well-specified work with a long runway — several applications

lined up, starting with the smaller tools.



What you'll build first: a standalone data-import tool — CSV upload, column mapping,

validation with duplicate and error detection, a staging-table review workflow, and

promotion into production Supabase tables. It ingests data produced by an automated

export script (I can provide the export; you may also help refine the export script,

which uses Node + Playwright). After that: a client photo gallery and print store

(Next.js, Supabase, Stripe checkout, discount codes, print-lab API), and then a larger

internal CRM (~30 screens, 7 user roles, Stripe/Affirm client payments, contractor

payouts via Mercury bank API).



What makes this job different: you will not be guessing what I want. You get complete

clickable design prototypes of every screen and a written technical spec — schema,

integrations, business rules, all d
. Your job is implementation done properly:

working code, tested edge cases, secure Row Level Security policies. No product

decisions, no design work, no scope mystery.



How we work:

- AI-assisted development is expected. You'll use Claude Code (I provide the

  plan/subscription). I care that you can direct it well, review its output critically,

  and catch its mistakes — not that you type every line.

- All infrastructure stays under my accounts (GitHub, Vercel, Supabase). You're added

  as a collaborator. Non-negotiable.

- Milestone-based delivery with clear acceptance criteria. I review the work, I respond

  fast, I pay on time.

- Starts with a small paid trial task so we both see if it's a fit.



Requirements:

- Strong TypeScript + Next.js, shipped at least one production app on Supabase or

  similar Postgres backend

- Real experience with payment APIs (Stripe or similar) — webhooks, not just checkout

- Understands Row Level Security / multi-tenant data isolation

- Comfortable with data-import work: CSV parsing, validation, deduplication, and

  browser automation (Playwright/Puppeteer) is a strong plus

- Writes and runs tests; can explain how you verify security, not just that "it works"

- Reliable communication in English, available for async work with occasional overlap

  to European hours



Rate: $8/hr to start, raised after the trial project for the right person. Long-term

relationship preferred over one-off gig.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — applications ignoring this are deleted):

Start your application with the word MERIDIAN. Then answer, in your own words:

1. Describe one project where you implemented Supabase Row Level Security. What data

   did it protect, and how did you TEST that the policies actually held?

2. A Stripe webhook arrives twice for the same payment. What goes wrong in a naive

   implementation, and how do you prevent it?

3. Link to one production project you built (live URL or repo) and state exactly which

   parts were yours.

title: Growth Lead — (Multi-Brand B2B Portfolio)
description:
This role must have fluent English (spoken and written) for daily collaboration and reporting.



About the Role:



We run a portfolio of B2B companies serving real estate professionals and SMBs — staffing, services, SaaS, and AI products. They share a buyer and a go-to-market motion, which means one well-built lead engine can serve all of them. That's the job.

You'll own demand generation across the portfolio: architect one repeatable, multi-brand lead machine — cold outbound, paid, and lifecycle running as a single system — and own the number it produces. This is a builder's role, not a campaign-runner's. You report to the CEO and operate autonomously: you set the plan, run it, and report weekly. We're not looking to manage you day-to-day.



This role only works for someone who has run multiple accounts at once. If you've lived in one brand your whole career, this will overwhelm you. If you've juggled a book of B2B clients and liked it, keep reading.



What You Own:



A monthly qualified-lead and pipeline target across all brands. You're accountable to the number.

One shared lead engine — built once in GoHighLevel, templated across brands — not four disconnected efforts.

Full-funnel demand gen: cold
 infrastructure (Instantly + Million Verifier), paid acquisition, landing pages, and funnels.

Brand-specific offers and messaging running on shared infrastructure. Same plumbing, distinct positioning per brand.

Lead-to-customer conversion: nurture, lifecycle automation, and clean handoff to sales.

A flexible contractor bench (PPC, copy, list-building) that you direct and scale as volume demands.

The numbers — CPL, stage conversion, CAC, pipeline contribution — reported weekly in a format the CEO reads in five minutes.



What We're Looking For:



4+ years in B2B demand generation, growth, or performance marketing — with agency or multi-brand experience. You've run 3+ accounts or brands simultaneously and it's second nature.

Full-funnel, not a single-channel specialist. You've built outbound engines and run paid and owned lifecycle. If your track record is only ad accounts and CPC optimization, this isn't your role.

A quantified track record: leads generated, CPL improved, pipeline driven. Bring numbers.

Proven cold-outbound experience at volume — deliverability, list hygiene, sequencing. This is a core channel here, not an afterthought.

A systems-builder by instinct. You build one machine and template it; you don't reinvent per brand.

Thinks in unit economics. If you can't tie a campaign to CAC and payback, pass.

Self-directed. You own the plan and the result without being managed into action.

Stack You'll Work In

GoHighLevel · Instantly · Million Verifier · Google Ads · Semrush · AI tools (Claude / ChatGPT for production speed). Deep fluency in any of these is a strong advantage.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days):



One shared, instrumented lead engine live across the priority brands — CPL and conversion baselined for each.

Cold outbound producing booked, qualified meetings consistently, across more than one brand.

A weekly portfolio pipeline report the CEO can trust at a glance.

One repeatable channel proven and ready to fund harder — and a contractor bench in place to scale it.



Compensation:



Base commensurate with a senior growth operator, plus performance upside tied directly to qualified-lead and pipeline targets. We pay for results and structure it so your incentives match ours.

Schedule:



Full-time, permanent. US Eastern (EST) hours required.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hello! My name is William, and I run GodSounds. We reach the world through Christian audiobooks and digital content, and we are growing quickly. Because of that, we want to make sure our internal workflows are clean, organized, and powered by the best modern automation tools available. Right now, I am looking to hire a highly capable AI automation specialist who can come in and help us streamline how the company operates by building no-code automations and AI-powered workflows.



This role is for someone who is already experienced with tools like Zapier and/or Make (Integromat), and who understands how to connect apps, create reliable automations, reduce repetitive work, and build systems that a team can actually use without breaking. We are not looking for someone who is just starting out or experimenting. We need someone who has real experience building automations for businesses and can confidently assess our current workflow, identify bottlenecks, and then build better systems step by step.



What we need is practical and internal: organizing workflows, tightening up how projects move through our pipeline, improving handoffs between tea
mbers, setting up automation for task creation, notifications, file organization, naming conventions, client onboarding flows, content workflows, and reporting. We want to use AI where it genuinely helps, such as auto-summarizing notes, turning transcripts into structured documents, generating drafts for internal use, routing requests to the right person, and reducing the amount of manual back-and-forth needed to keep the company moving. The goal is simple: help GodSounds operate faster, cleaner, and with less stress by using smart systems.



You should be comfortable designing workflows, documenting them clearly, and communicating with a team so the automations actually get adopted. If you have experience with CRMs, Airtable, Notion, ClickUp, Trello, Google Drive organization, Slack automations,
 automations, webhooks, APIs, and basic troubleshooting, that is a big plus. We value someone who thinks like an operator, not just a tech person - someone who can simplify complexity and build systems that are stable, repeatable, and easy to maintain.



This will start as a part-time role, with the opportunity to grow into more responsibility as we scale and as you prove you can deliver real workflow improvements. When you apply, please tell me how much experience you have building automations for companies, what tools you use most (Zapier, Make, Airtable, Notion, etc.), and give examples of workflows you have built that saved time or reduced manual work. If possible, share screenshots, Loom videos, or a simple breakdown of what you built, what problem it solved, and the results.



Bonus (not required, but strongly preferred): please record a short video of yourself (1-3 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for the GodSounds team. Your English does not need to be perfect. I mainly want to get a feel for who you are, how you think, and how you communicate. If you choose to do the video, just send me a link.



If you are an experienced AI automation and no-code workflow specialist and you want to help build a truly efficient internal system for a fast-growing company, I would love to hear from you. Thank you, and God bless you - I’m excited to meet the right person to join our team.

A major part of this role is publishing and launching. We need someone who knows how to package and submit apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, understands the common requirements and approval process, and can help us avoid beginner mistakes that slow launches down. If you can also help with basic maintenance, updates, bug fixes, and improvements after launch, that is a big plus.



We already have a creative team (video editing and graphic design), so you will not be alone on visuals. What we need is someone who can lead the no-code app build process, communicate clearly, stay organized, and deliver results. This will start as a part-time role with the opportunity to grow into more work and more responsibility as we build more apps.

Bonus (not required, but strongly preferred): please record a short video of yourself (1-3 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for the GodSounds team. Your English does not need to be perfect - I mainly want to get a feel for who you are, how you think, and how you communicate. If you choose to do the video, just send me a link.



If you are experienced in no-code app building and you can help us build and launch apps efficiently, I would love to hear from you. Thank you, and God bless you - I’m excited to meet the right person to join our team.

title: VA & Business Support/Payroll/Administrator
description:
Practice Administrator / Virtual Executive Assistant

UK Accountancy Firm — Full-Time, UK Hours

Employer: Astons Accountants & Business Advisors Limited (UK)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours/week — UK business hours (see below)

Start date: As soon as possible



About us

We are a growing, well-established chartered certified accountancy practice based in St Albans, England, serving over 1,000 clients — mainly owner-managed businesses, property investors, and healthcare practices. We're a friendly, close-knit team that invests heavily in modern systems and automation, and we're now building out our remote support function.

This is a long-term role for the right person. We're not looking for a short-term freelancer — we want someone who will become a core part of the team, learn our systems inside out, and grow with the firm.

The role

You'll be our Virtual PA to the Director, and Business Support/Practice Administrator — the engine room of the firm's admin function. You'll own the day-to-day administrative processes that keep a busy accountancy practice running: client onboarding, statutory filings, chasing information, preparing engagement documents, and keeping our practice management system accurate and up to date.

You'll work closely with our UK-based team, who will handle anything requiring a physical presence (post, in-person matters) — everything digital is yours.

Full training on our specific systems and processes will be provided, including recorded walkthroughs and written procedures for every task.

Day-to-day responsibilities

• Client onboarding — setting up new clients in our systems, issuing letters of engagement, running ID verification checks, and requesting professional clearance from previous accountants

• Letters of engagement (LoE) — drafting, issuing, and chasing signed engagement documents

• Companies House filings — preparing and filing confirmation statements (CS01s) and other statutory forms

• Chasing — following up with clients by
 for missing records, signed accounts pages, approvals, and outstanding information

• Debtor management, and invoicing — sending payment reminders and following up on unpaid invoices by
, and raising invoices for the team. 

• Payroll support — assisting with payroll preparation and administration, if you can manage the payroll function entirely, that would be ideal. 

• Post triage — reviewing scanned incoming post, filing it to the correct client folder, and drafting notification
s to clients or client managers

• Practice management housekeeping — keeping client records, deadlines, and task workflows accurate and up to date

• General admin — filing, document management, and supporting the wider team in a business support and administrative function. 

• Private PA to the Director – including personal bills, household admin, property portfolio help, and all personal help with the Directors busy both home, personal and work schedule. 



Working hours

This role works UK business hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:30pm UK time.

Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable working this shift long-term. Real-time availability during UK hours is essential to this role.

Must-have requirements

• 2+ years' experience in a virtual assistant, administration, or bookkeeping role — ideally supporting a UK business. 

• Excellent written English — you'll be
ing our clients directly, so your written communication must be professional, warm, and error-free

• Highly organised and detail-obsessed — much of this work involves statutory deadlines where accuracy matters

• Self-managing — able to work through a task list independently, flag problems early, and ask good questions

• Reliable home office setup — fast, stable internet (minimum 25 Mbps with backup), a modern computer, and a quiet working environment

• Comfortable with confidential data — you'll handle sensitive client financial information; a signed confidentiality agreement and an NBI clearance will be required

Nice to have (but not essential — we will train you)

• Experience with UK accountancy firms or knowledge of UK compliance (Companies House, HMRC)

• Familiarity with any of: Xero, TaxCalc, BrightManager, BrightPay, Dext, or Microsoft 365/SharePoint

• Bookkeeping or accounts experience

• Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to work more efficiently — we're a very tech-forward firm and actively encourage this

What we offer

• Competitive monthly salary, paid reliably and on time

• Long-term, stable, full-time role — not project-based

• Full training, documented procedures, and ongoing support from our UK team

• Modern systems and tools — we automate the boring stuff so you can do interesting work

• Genuine opportunity to grow as the firm grows — we've doubled in size through acquisitions and are still expanding



How to apply

To show us you've read this post carefully, please start your application with the word “PARKWAY” in the first line. Applications that don't include it will not be considered.

Then please include:

1. A short cover note telling us about your experience supporting overseas businesses, and confirming you're comfortable with the UK-hours shift

2. Your CV/résumé

3. Your internet speed test result (screenshot from speedtest.net)

4. Your expected monthly salary

We'll shortlist quickly and invite selected candidates to a video interview.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Cheff of Staff - Ecommerce Operations
description:
What We’re Really Looking For

You’ve walked the path. You’ve managed ecommerce businesses, coordinated marketing campaigns, dealt with Amazon listing issues at 2am, and know what breaks when you scale. You don’t just manage projects — you understand the business.



This isn’t a “run meetings and update trackers” role. You’ll work directly with founders to take ownership of the business workflows, bring order to chaos, and use tech/AI to create leverage wherever possible. Every team, every project, every cross-functional handoff — you’re the one making sure it all moves.

Reporting: Directly to Founders

Type: Leadership role with full operational ownership

- Own End-to-End Execution

- Lead cross-functional projects from idea to launch across ecommerce channels, marketing campaigns, product launches, and catalogue management

- Break down founder vision into executable roadmaps with clear milestones and accountability

- Unblock teams in real-time and keep things moving fast



Marketing Team Coordination & Execution

- Work closely with the marketing team on campaign planning, creative workflows, and launch coordination

, and content teams

- Set up tracking systems that give founders visibility without drowning them in reports

- Establish rituals (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews) that drive results, not just meetings

Leverage Technology & Automation

- Manage projects and workflows through Asana

- Spot repetitive work and automate it (Zapier, Make, AI tools, n8n)

- Stay current on AI and automation trends; test what gives us an edge

- Push the team toward tech-enabled efficiency



Cross-Functional Leadership

- Coordinate across ecommerce, marketing, catalogue, creative, and support teams

- Translate business priorities into clear action plans with owners

- Run productive meetings that end with decisions and next steps

- Manage internal tea
mbers, contractors, and agency partners



Drive Results & Accountability

- Anticipate risks before they become problems

- Ensure projects ship on time, within scope, and actually move the business forward

- Provide weekly updates to founders with real insight, not just status reports

- Own outcomes, not just outputs



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

- You’ve taken ownership of 3–5 active initiatives and brought clarity to what was chaos

- Marketing team projects are running smoother with clear workflows and timelines

- Founders have visibility into what’s happening without having to ask

- You’ve implemented 2–3 automations that save the team hours every week

- The team actually uses the systems you’ve built



You’re a Great Fit If You Have

Must-Haves

- 8–12 years working in ecommerce or digital businesses (agency, brand, or marketplace side)

- Direct experience managing ecommerce operations on platforms like Shopify, Amazon, Wayfair, or Walmart

- Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals and campaign execution — you’ve coordinated marketing teams or projects before

- Startup or high-growth company experience where you wore multiple hats and figured things out

- Hands-on experience with project management tools (Asana strongly preferred)

- Track record of building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — not just operating within existing ones

- Proven ability to lead and manage people with real authority — not just coordinate

- Track record of getting things done in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

- Experience managing remote teams across time zones

- Tech-savvy mindset — comfortable with new tools and AI/automation



Bonus Points

- Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as their operational right hand

- Background in catalogue management, product launches, or creative operations

- Hands-on experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, ChatGPT, n8n)

- Knowledge of SEO, marketplaces, or ecommerce analytics

- Experience scaling a business from early stage — you’ve seen what breaks at $1M, $5M, $10M



Tools You’ll Work With

- Project & Collaboration: Asana, Notion, Slack, Loom, Google Workspace

- Ecommerce Platforms: Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, marketplace dashboards, ERP/OMS tools

- Automation & AI: Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT, various AI tools



Work Setup

This is a fully remote role. You must have:

- Your own reliable laptop/desktop system

- Stable internet connection

- Professional home office setup

- Company-issued hardware is not provided.



Why Join our Company?

- Direct Founder Access — You’ll work directly with founders who value execution over bureaucracy. Your voice matters.

- High Ownership — This isn’t a “wait for instructions” role. You’ll own real business outcomes and shape how we operate.

- Remote Flexibility — Work from anywhere with flexible hours, as long as you have EST overlap for key collaborations.

- Fast-Paced Growth — We’re scaling quickly across channels. You’ll see the direct impact of your work on revenue and growth.

- Tech-Forward Culture — We embrace automation, AI, and smart systems. If you love finding better ways to work, you’ll thrive here.

- No Micromanagement — Clear expectations, full autonomy, and trust. We hire adults and treat them like adults.

Type: Ongoing, long-term. We want someone to grow with us, not a one-off gig.



About the work:



We run content and SEO for CyberPR, a New York-based PR and visibility company for independent musicians. You'd be the person who keeps our WordPress site clean and current: publishing blog posts, updating older content, and managing redirects so nothing breaks. You'd work from clear instructions in Google Sheets, and we'll train you on anything you don't already know.

We care more about someone reliable, detail-oriented, and teachable than someone who already knows every tool. If you follow instructions carefully, ask good questions, and double-check your own work, you'll do well here.



This role has real upside. The right person won't stay at 20 hours for long. As you prove yourself, we'll add hours and bring you into our AI-assisted content work, using AI tools to help draft, research, and produce content faster. If you're curious about AI and want to build that skill, this is a place to do it.



What you'll do:



 - Publish blog posts in WordPress from drafts we provide (formatting, images, internal links, categories)

 - Update and refresh existing pages and posts based on a checklist

 - Set up and manage redirects when URLs change (we'll show you our process)

 - Fill in SEO fields like page titles and meta descriptions using our SEO plugin (we'll train you on it)

 - Work from Google Sheets that tell you exactly what to publish, update, or redirect

 - Keep the tracking sheet updated so we always know what's done

 - Occasionally pull simple data from Google Analytics and Search Console (nice to have, not required)



You're a good fit if you have:



 - Solid hands-on WordPress experience (publishing and editing, not just browsing)

 - Strong attention to detail. Small errors in links and formatting matter to us.

 - Comfort working in Google Sheets and following written instructions

 - Good written English and steady communication (you tell us when something's unclear or blocked)

 - Reliable internet and a quiet setup for occasional calls

 - Willingness to learn our SEO plugin and redirect process



Nice to have (not required):



 - Basic SEO understanding (titles, meta descriptions, headings)

 - Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 or Search Console



How to apply:

 - Answer this: A blog post's URL needs to change from /old-title to /new-title. In one or two sentences, what would you do so visitors and Google still land in the right place? (It's fine if you're not sure of the exact steps. We want to see how you think.)

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — Automotive & Renewable Energy Brands (AU Company)
description:
FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — AUTOMOTIVE & RENEWABLE ENERGY BRANDS (AU COMPANY)



Salary: AUD $1,000–$1,650/month depending on skill and portfolio

Type: Full-time, permanent, remote (Philippines-based)

Hours: Flexible — work whenever suits you, as long as agreed videos are delivered on schedule. One fixed daily check-in window (approx. 1 hour, overlapping Australian Eastern business hours) for briefs, feedback, and planning.

Start: ASAP



ABOUT US



We run two Australian brands: an automotive carbon fibre parts brand with a growing social presence and paid ads program, and a national solar & battery wholesale distribution business. Both need a steady stream of high-quality video content — and we already have the scripts, hooks, and raw footage pipeline. We need someone who can turn that into finished videos, fast.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



- Short-form paid ads for Meta and TikTok (15–60 seconds) — this is the core of the role

- Product and brand videos for automotive parts (carbon fibre fenders, fitment content, competition campaigns)

- Installer spotlight content for our renewable energy brand: on-site footage of installers fitting our products, interviews about their business and why they chose specific products — cut into videos that build their brand and ours

- Manufacturer partner content (Alpha ESS, FranklinWH, JA Solar, Nova Racking and others): product demos, how-to videos, and installer testimonials



Much of the renewables content is filmed in the field — talking-head interviews and job-site footage. You'll need to be comfortable cutting interview content, pulling the best soundbites, and cleaning up real-world audio.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING FROM



You won't be starting from a blank page. We provide hook scripts, ad copy, raw footage, and clear briefs. Your job is speed and craft: take the brief, cut the video, deliver it on time.



HOW WE WORK



- Flexible hours. We don't track when you work — we track what gets delivered. You'll have an agreed weekly output schedule, and how you organise your day around it is up to you.

- One daily sync window. A fixed ~1-hour window each weekday (overlapping Australian Eastern business hours) where you're available for briefs, feedback, and quick calls.

- Clear briefs, fast feedback. Every video comes with a brief. We respond to drafts quickly so nothing sits in limbo.



MUST-HAVES



- 2+ years editing short-form social/ad content (portfolio required — ads, not vlogs or weddings)

- You understand hooks, retention, and pacing — you can explain WHY the first 2 seconds of your edits work

- Fast, reliable turnaround — you can deliver multiple short-form edits per week

- Your own editing setup: capable computer and the software you already know best. We don't care what you edit in — we care what comes out the other end.

- Fast, reliable internet (capable of regularly downloading large raw footage files) plus a backup internet option and backup power plan for outages

- Captioning/subtitling for sound-off viewing

- Comfortable cutting interview/talking-head footage and cleaning up field audio

- Organised file management and clear written communication in English



NICE-TO-HAVES



- You bring creative ideas — suggesting hooks, formats, or angles we haven't thought of (not required, but valued; the core job is editing)

- Ability to travel to Manila roughly once per month for filming days, with your own camera equipment (not required — travel expenses covered if you can; if this is you, tell us what gear you shoot with in your application)

- Motion graphics / text animation beyond basics

- Experience editing automotive or trades/technical content

- Experience with ad creative testing (batch variations, hook swaps)

- Basic thumbnail/graphic design



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with:

1. Links to your 3 BEST SHORT-FORM ADS (not a showreel — individual videos)

2. ONE SENTENCE PER VIDEO explaining the hook strategy

3. 2–3 VIDEOS YOU'VE EDITED IN THE LAST 60 DAYS — uploaded or linked, any format. We want to see your current output, not just your highlight reel.

4. A screenshot of an internet SPEED TEST and your COMPUTER SPECS + EDITING SOFTWARE

5. Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date



Applications missing any of the above will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be offered a PAID TEST EDIT — a one-off flat fee of AUD $55 for the completed video, to be delivered within 48 hours of receiving assets.

title: AI Bible Song Assistant (VA)
description:
GodSounds is looking for someone who loves Jesus, enjoys music, and is excited about using AI to help build a brand-new Bible song app.



Our vision is to create an app where people can listen to the books and chapters of the Bible in many different musical genres. Imagine listening to Ephesians as worship music, Proverbs as acoustic folk, Psalms as cinematic orchestral music, or Romans as rap.



We are looking for someone who can help us create those songs using AI music generation tools such as Suno AI.



What You’ll Do



You will use AI to help create Bible songs in a variety of musical styles.



Typical assignments might look like:



* Create the Book of Ephesians as modern worship music.

* Create selected Psalms as cinematic orchestral music.

* Create Proverbs in acoustic folk.

* Create Romans in hip-hop.

* Create James in country.

* Create Philippians in lo-fi.



We already have high-quality prompts and workflows that we will provide. Your job is to use those prompts, evaluate the results, and continue refining them until the music sounds excellent.



Your Responsibilities



* Generate Bible songs using Suno AI.

* Listen carefully to each version Suno creates.

* Choose the strongest version from the available generations.

* Regenerate songs when pronunciation, pacing, or musical quality needs improvement.

* Watch for incorrect pronunciation of Bible names and places.

* Use pronunciation tools when necessary to improve results.

* Organize and download the final songs.

* Upload completed songs to our Google Drive.

* Help organize projects for future release in our Bible music app.



Album Cover Creation



Each Bible album also needs professional cover artwork.



Using ChatGPT, Nano Banana, or similar AI image tools, you will create attractive album covers that match the style and mood of each project.



Examples might include:



* The Book of John

* Psalms Worship Collection

* Proverbs Wisdom Songs

* Romans

* Ephesians

* The Gospel Collection



We’re looking for artwork that feels beautiful, premium, and professionally designed.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Loves Jesus Christ and enjoys reading the Bible.

* Has a good understanding of the books of the Bible.

* Has a great ear for music.

* Enjoys many different musical genres.

* Can recognize when a song sounds natural versus awkward.

* Pays attention to details like pronunciation and vocal quality.

* Has experience using Suno AI or is excited to learn quickly.

* Can use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Nano Banana to create album artwork.

* Is organized, dependable, and communicates well.



Experience as a musician is helpful but not required. Having excellent musical taste is much more important.



Hours



Initially:



* 5-10 hours per week



As this project grows, additional hours may become available.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship.



Pay



Our current budget is:



* $3-$7 USD per hour, depending on experience, quality, and consistency.



Trial Project



Please create a small sample project so we can see your creativity.



Music



Using Suno AI (or another AI music generation tool), create one or more short Bible song examples.



You may choose any passage or chapter from the Bible.



Choose any musical genre you think sounds great.



We want to hear your musical taste and your ability to use AI to create polished, enjoyable songs.



Album Cover



Create album artwork for each sample song using ChatGPT, Nano Banana, or another AI image generation tool.



The artwork should look modern, attractive, and appropriate for a Christian music app.



Submission



Please upload everything into a Google Drive folder containing:



* Your sample song(s)

* Album cover artwork

* Any prompts you used (optional but appreciated)



We want to see both your musical creativity and your visual design ability.



When You Apply



Please include:



* A short introduction about yourself.

* Your experience with Suno AI or other AI music generation tools.

* Your experience with ChatGPT, Nano Banana, or other AI image generation tools.

* Your hourly rate.

* How many hours you are available each week.

* A Google Drive link containing your sample songs and album artwork.

* Any experience with music production, songwriting, worship music, or audio editing.

* Anything else that helps us understand why you’d be a great fit.



You can also look up GodSounds to learn more about our company and our mission.



If this project is successful, we expect this to become a long-term position as we continue building one of the world’s largest AI-powered Bible music libraries.

title: Residential Real Estate Legal Assistant for U.S. Law Firm (July 2026)
description:
Schedule: Part-time. About 20-25 hours per week.



Time Zone: Must be able to overlap with U.S. Central Time



Compensation: Based on experience.



Initial trial period: 60 days at $6/hour. Compensation may be reviewed after the trial period based on performance, reliability, experience, and fit.



About the Role:

We are a U.S.-based real estate law firm looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive legal assistant to support residential real estate transactions from contract to closing.



This is not a brokerage transaction coordinator role, listing coordinator role, lead management role, cold-calling role, or general real estate VA role.



We are looking for someone who understands real estate transactions and can work in a legal environment, including attorney review, inspection deadlines, title coordination, lender coordination, closing preparation, client communication, document organization, and attorney escalation.



Main Responsibilities:

- Open and set up new real estate matters

- Review contracts and
s to identify key transaction details

- Enter and update client, agent, lender, attorney, and title company contact information

- Track key dates, deadlines, and missing information

- Coordinate with real estate agents, lenders, title companies, opposing counsel, and clients

- Prepare standard documents and
s using templates

- Organize
s, documents, and matter files

- Follow up on missing information or pending items

- Prepare files for attorney review

- Flag unusual, unclear, urgent, or non-standard issues for the attorney

- Support closing preparation and post-closing follow-up

- Maintain task lists and update matter status clearly



Experience We Are Looking For



Strong candidates will have experience with some of the following:

- U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Contract-to-closing coordination

- Buyer-side and/or seller-side transaction support

- Real estate law firm support

- Real estate transaction coordination

- Title company, escrow, mortgage, or brokerage transaction support

- Attorney review process

- Inspection deadlines

- Lender coordination

- Title coordination

- HOA or condo document requests

- Closing preparation

- Closing statements or settlement statements

- Real estate document organization



Experience with Illinois residential real estate transactions is a plus, but not required.



Tools and Systems



Experience with these tools is helpful, but not required:

- Microsoft Outlook

- Microsoft Teams

- Microsoft To Do

- Microsoft SharePoint or OneDrive

- Smokeball, Clio, Odoo, or similar practice management systems

- Adobe Acrobat

- E-signature platforms

- Real estate transaction management systems



You do not need to know every system before starting, but you must be comfortable learning new tools and following detailed SOPs.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You Are:

- Able to think in context, not just complete isolated tasks

- Very organized

- Detail-oriented

- Careful with deadlines

- Comfortable following written instructions and SOPs

- Able to communicate clearly in writing

- Proactive about asking good questions

- Able to notice when something needs attorney review

- Comfortable working with many
s, documents, deadlines, and exceptions

- Reliable, consistent, and accountable

- Calm under pressure

- Interested in long-term work with a small professional team

- Impeccable written and spoken English



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If:

- Your real estate experience is mainly brokerage support, listing coordination, showing coordination, lead generation, CRM updates, social media, cold calling, or agent admin

- You are looking for a general real estate VA role rather than a legal-support role inside a law firm

- You are hoping this role is mostly posting listings, updating CRMs, or making things look nice in Canva

- You have worked around real estate transactions but have not been responsible for contract-to-closing file coordination

- You treat each instruction as a separate task without considering the full status of the matter

- You only have general admin or data entry experience

- You have never worked with U.S. real estate transactions

- Your legal experience is mainly with local court filings, municipal courts, litigation, criminal matters, family law, immigration, or court-based legal work outside the U.S.

- You have general legal experience but no direct experience with U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Your real estate experience is limited to property research, data entry, lead generation, cold calling, or CRM updates

- You need constant reminders about what to do next

- You are uncomfortable reading contracts,
s, and transaction documents

- You are not detail-oriented

- You do not like documenting your work clearly

- You struggle to follow multi-step processes

- You prefer simple repetitive tasks with no judgment involved

- You believe “I did not know” is a good replacement for asking a clear question

- You think this job posting is too long to read carefully



Important Expectation:

> This role requires initiative, context, and judgment.



> The best real estate transaction coordinators do not treat each instruction as an isolated task. They constantly ask: What is the status of this matter, what has already happened, and what needs to happen next without creating confusion, duplication, or risk?



For example, before sending a document, a strong coordinator should think through whether the document is complete, whether it is the correct version, who needs to receive it, whether it has already been sent, whether it is meant for internal or external use, and whether sending it could create a deadline, legal issue, duplicate file, or client confusion.



You will not be expected to provide legal advice. However, you will be expected to understand the context of the matter, notice when something is missing, unusual, unclear, urgent, or outside the normal process, and flag those items for attorney review.



For example, a strong tea
mber should be able to notice when:

- The contract is missing the buyer’s attorney information

- The inspection deadline appears to be tomorrow

- The title company contact is not listed

- The client’s phone number is missing

- A transaction appears to involve a condo or HOA

- An issue should be flagged for attorney review

 A short summary of your experience with U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Who did you coordinate with?

- What documents or deadlines were involved?

- What is your availability in U.S. Central Time?

- What is your expected hourly rate or monthly salary?



To show that you read the full job post carefully and can follow written instructions, please include the words "yellow pumpkin" in the subject line of your
.

About PropFix.ie



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. Professional Skills

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client and contractor liaison

Organization: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

title: Appointment Setter – B2B Cold Calling (Debt Relief for Business Owners)
description:
We run a lead generation operation helping US small business owners restructure expensive merchant cash advance (MCA) debt. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: call business owners, have a real conversation about their situation, and book qualified appointments for our closers.



You'll be calling warm-ish data — these are business owners we've identified as likely carrying multiple cash advances, not random lists. A lot of calls won't connect. When they do, you need to sound like a human, not a script reader.



What You'll Do



Make
+ outbound dials per day during US business hours (EST)



Qualify business owners: confirm they have MCA debt, gauge pain level, and book a call with our team



Log every call outcome in Close CRM (dispositions, notes, callbacks)



Handle objections like "I'm not interested" and "how did you get my number" without folding



Hit a target of 3-5 qualified appointments per week



Requirements



1+ years of B2B cold calling experience (US market strongly preferred)

Excellent spoken English with minimal accent — you'll be talking to skeptical American business owners

Experience with a sales CRM (Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

Reliable internet (backup connection preferred), quiet workspace, quality headset

Able to work US Eastern Time hours

Thick skin and consistency — this is a volume game with a lot of rejection



Nice to Have



Experience in financial services, debt relief, MCA, or business lending

Familiarity with Close CRM specifically



Compensation



Rate: Starting at $5 per hour 

Bonus: $[20} / per closed deal 

Paid weekly via Wise





How to Apply

Send a short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and telling me about your cold calling experience. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Put the word "CHAMPION" in the first line of your application so I know you read this.

title: Music Startup Looking For Customer Support
description:
Hey there! We are a Brooklyn based music software startup. Our mission is to help music artists get more fans for their music.



We are looking for a customer support professional to join our team (full-time).



This is an immediate opening, and we are trying to hire as soon as possible. Our compensation package includes base salary + paid time off + bonuses.



*** Responsibilities include ***



• Manage and respond to customer support request tickets in Zendesk (We offer
/ticket support. No chat. No phone)

• Manage articles in our customer support center to add new content and keep existing content up to date

• Support the community management of our
 group by responding to questions and comments

• Assist our marketing team by monitoring
/Instagram ads for questions and comments

• Share insights from support management with our team to help with product development

• Overall, help artists to be more successful with our software



We are a really small team with a pretty flat hierarchy. We are looking for someone who is ready to grow with us for years to come. You will work directly with our head of customer support and also with me, the founder of the business.



*** What are looking for in a tea
mber ***



• Self-starter with a can-do attitude

• Positive and friendly

• Problem-solver mentality

• Excellent English speaker/writer

• Strong communication skills (casual jargon OK… we are not a bank :)

• Musician/music artist

• Access to your own laptop and stable high-speed Wi-Fi as this is a remote position



*** About the role ***



We are a global team with many tea
mbers in different time zones. You can self-manage your time. For the most part, you do NOT need to be online during typical office hours for the Eastern Time Zone in the US. Working hours are flexible.



However, please just plan for calls during US office hours every once in a while, so we may go over any questions you may have, provide training, or share feedback. But this will likely be the exception.



*** Important qualification criteria ***



We believe that in order to help music artists in our community with their success, you MUST BE A PASSIONATE MUSICIAN/MUSIC ARTIST YOURSELF AND HAVE PUBLISHED SOME OF YOUR MUSIC ON SPOTIFY. We believe that this is a critical qualification for this role. As a musician/music artist (any genre OK), you can use our software for yourself, grow your own fanbase, and use your experience to help other artists in our community.

*** To apply for this role, please submit the following ***

• Let us know why you believe you’re a good fit

Cheers!

title: Christian Video Editor (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels & TikTok)
description:
GodSounds is looking for a talented Christian video editor to help churches reach more people through high-quality short-form video.



We create Christian media and are expanding into helping churches grow their online presence by turning powerful sermon 
nts into engaging YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok videos.



If you love Jesus, enjoy great storytelling, and know how to create videos that stop people from scrolling, we’d love to hear from you.



What You’ll Do



* Use AI tools such as Gemini to help find powerful sermon clips.

* Turn those 
nts into highly engaging short videos.

* Add professional captions, B-roll, motion graphics, zooms, sound effects, music (when appropriate), and smooth transitions.

* Create videos that immediately capture attention and keep viewers watching.

* Deliver polished, professional edits suitable for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok.



Church Research & Outreach



A unique part of this position is helping us find future church clients.



We will teach you our process step by step.



Your responsibilities may include:



* Research churches in the United States on YouTube.

* Identify churches that upload full sermons but are not consistently using YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok.

* Identify churches whose current short-form content could be improved.

* Use AI tools such as Gemini to locate the strongest 
nts in a sermon.

* Create one free sample short from that sermon.

* Send the completed short to our team so we can use it as part of our outreach.



If that church becomes a client, you will likely continue creating shorts for them.



Workload



Initially:



* 5-10 shorts per week



As we grow:



* 10-30 shorts per week



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship as this business grows.



Pay



Our current budget is approximately:



* $3-$8 USD per completed short, depending on quality, experience, and turnaround time.



There will also be opportunities for additional paid work involving church research and outreach.



We’re Looking For Someone Who



* Loves Jesus Christ and understands Christian sermons.

* Can recognize meaningful, emotional, encouraging, or challenging 
nts in a message.

* Has experience editing YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok videos.

* Knows how to create strong hooks that keep viewers watching.

* Creates clean, professional captions and graphics.

* Has a good sense of pacing and storytelling.

* Is comfortable using AI tools such as Gemini (or is willing to learn).

* Is dependable, communicates well, and consistently meets deadlines.



Trial Project



Please create one sample short using this sermon:







Instructions:



* Use Gemini (or another AI tool) to help identify one of the strongest 
nts from the sermon.

* Create one short between 20-40 seconds.

* Start with a strong hook.

* Add professional captions.

* Use B-roll, zooms, graphics, animations, or other editing techniques where appropriate.

* End with a strong conclusion.

* Show us your creativity and editing ability.



We are looking for editors who can create highly engaging Christian short-form content that people genuinely enjoy watching.



When You Apply



Please include the following information:



* A short introduction about yourself.

* Your experience editing YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok videos.

* Your price per completed short video.

* Your hourly rate for researching churches and identifying potential leads.

* Approximately how many hours you believe you could dedicate each week.

* A link to your test short from the above sermon link



Bonus Skills (Optional)



This is not required, but it is a big plus.



If you can also create beautiful, on-brand social media graphics using ChatGPT Image or another AI image generation tool, we’d love to see your work.



For example, after creating a short from a sermon, you could take a powerful quote from that message and turn it into one or more professional social media graphics that match the church’s style and branding.



Being able to create both high-quality short-form videos and engaging AI-generated graphics is a valuable skill and may lead to additional work.



Along with your test short, feel free to include one or more AI-generated quote graphics based on the same sermon.



Please upload them to the same Google Drive folder as your sample short.



This is completely optional, but it will help us evaluate your creative abilities and AI design skills.



You can also look up GodSounds to learn more about our company and the work we do. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for the long term. If this project is successful, we expect ongoing work as we continue serving more churches across the United States.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts)
description:
We're looking for a creative and experienced video editor who specializes in **short-form content** for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



Our content focuses on entrepreneurship, Amazon FBA, business, family, and lifestyle. We're looking for someone who understands social media trends, viewer retention, and storytelling—not just someone who can make cuts.



If you're passionate about creating engaging content that keeps people watching, we'd love to hear from you.



## Responsibilities



* Edit Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts from raw footage and long-form YouTube videos

* Create attention-grabbing hooks within the first 1–3 seconds

* Add captions, sound effects, music, B-roll, graphics, zooms, and motion where appropriate

* Keep edits fast-paced while maintaining a clean, professional look

* Repurpose long-form content into multiple short-form clips

* Occasionally edit 5–10 minute YouTube videos

* Organize project files and deliver projects on time

* Communicate quickly throughout each project



What We're Looking For



* Proven experience editing high-quality short-form content

* Strong understanding of viewer retention and pacing

* Excellent storytelling skills

* Strong English comprehension

* Reliable communication and quick response times

* Consistent history of delivering quality work on schedule

* Experience with **Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro** (preferred)

* After Effects, motion graphics, and animation experience are a plus



Bonus Points If You...



* Stay up to date on Instagram and YouTube trends

* Understand what makes viewers stop scrolling and keep watching

* Can identify the best 
nts from long-form videos and turn them into engaging short-form content without detailed instructions

* Have experience editing business, educational, or creator-focused content



This Position Is NOT For You If...



* You frequently miss deadlines.

* You disappear without communicating.

* You rely heavily on templates instead of creative editing.

* You require constant follow-up to complete projects.



To Apply



**IMPORTANT:** Begin your application with the words: **Nimbus Cloud**



Then include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. How long you've been editing professionally.

3. Links to **3 of your best Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or TikToks.**

4. Links to **3 YouTube videos** you've edited.

5. Tell us about a short-form video you're most proud of and why you think it performed well.

6. **If you've edited a Reel, Short, or TikTok with over 100,000 views, include a link and briefly explain what editing decisions you believe contributed to its performance.** (If you haven't, simply tell us which project you're most proud of and why.)

7. What editing software you use.

8. Your average turnaround time for:

   * One Instagram Reel or YouTube Short

   * One 5–10 minute YouTube video

9. Your expected hourly rate or fixed price per project.

10. Did you use AI to complete the application for this job?



Final Question (Required)



To prove you've read this entire job post, answer this question at the very end of your application:



**What two colors does Goku wear in Season 1 of the popular anime Dragon Ball Z?**



Applications that do not begin with **"Nimbus Cloud"** and do not answer the final question will not be considered.



We're looking for someone we'd like to work with long-term. If you're dependable, creative, communicative, and enjoy helping creators grow, we'd love to see your work.

title: AI Graphic Designer (ChatGPT & Nano Banana)

 & Instagram) advertising, websites, landing pages, and social media.



We’re not looking for traditional graphic design. We’re looking for someone who knows how to use AI to create professional, on-brand marketing images quickly and consistently.

or



“Create several carousel concepts promoting this app.”



Your job is to turn those ideas into polished marketing graphics that are ready to test in advertising campaigns.

* Has excellent visual taste and knows what makes a graphic look premium.

* Can recognize when an AI image looks unrealistic or low quality and improve it.

* Understands branding and consistency.

* Can follow creative direction while also bringing fresh ideas.

* Is organized and communicates well.

* Wants to build a long-term working relationship.



Experience with Meta advertising creatives is a bonus but not required.



Hours



Initially this position will be:



* A few hours each week



As our marketing grows, this can expand into:



* 10+ hours per week



We are looking for someone interested in growing with our company long term.



Pay



Our current budget is:



* $3-$8 USD per hour, depending on experience, quality, speed, and creativity.



Trial Project



Please visit both of our websites:



GodSounds







PneumaBreath







After looking through both websites, create several marketing graphics that demonstrate your creativity.

* Static Meta ad graphics

* Promotional images for an audiobook

* Promotional graphics for the PneumaBreath app

* Graphics highlighting free resources

* Brand awareness graphics

* Any additional creative ideas you think would perform well as ads



We are intentionally giving you creative freedom because we want to see your design style, prompt-writing ability, and overall eye for marketing.



Please submit your work in a Google Drive folder or another easy-to-view format.



When You Apply



Please include:



* A short introduction about yourself.

* Your hourly rate.

* Approximately how many hours you can work each week.

* Your test graphics based on the GodSounds and PneumaBreath websites



You can also look up GodSounds to learn more about our company and our mission.



If this position is a good fit, we expect it to become a long-term role as we continue growing our marketing efforts.

As the Donor and Fundraising Officer, you will be responsible for overseeing grant reporting and compliance, from Parity and the SOS Fund’s variety of funding sources including philanthropic foundations, corporate foundations, private donors, government funding including federal, state, and city, and construction debt. You will also be responsible for grant writing using pre-canned templates for future funding opportunities, and for nurturing new relationships with donors. Budgets and Reporting

o Oversee the production of periodic financial reports on Parity programs

o Liaise with third-party bookkeeping firm to ensure proper on-time accounts payable, payroll, appropriate transaction categorization, and monthly close out

title: Weekday Care Operations Coordinator
description:

-Ensuring timely, accurate follow-up 

-Escalating issues appropriately 



Core Responsibilities

Review and manage all incoming communication from: 



HelloSells (call notes, messages, requests) 



Clients and caregivers 



System alerts (Phoebe) 



Maintain a structured communication queue 



Categorize all items: 



Urgent (requires immediate action) 



Same-day priority (handled within defined timeframes) 



Non-urgent (handled during scheduled callback blocks)

Review and act on exceptions generated by systems, including: 



Unfilled shifts after automated attempts 



Caregiver call-outs or no-shows 



Follow defined workflows to: 



Resolve issues when possible 



Escalate when appropriate 



Escalate the following to leadership: 



Client complaints or dissatisfaction 



Caregiver conflicts 



Complex or sensitive situations 



3. Client Communication (High-Value Interactions) 



Proactively communicate with clients regarding: 



Late caregivers 



Call-outs and coverage updates 



Service-related concerns 



Ensure clients are informed before issues escalate 



Maintain a professional, calm, and solution-oriented tone 



 



4. Callback & Follow-Up Management 



Return non-urgent calls and messages during structured callback blocks 



Follow up on: 



Client requests 



Caregiver questions 



Outstanding issues 



Ensure all communication is completed within defined response time standards 



Caregiver check ins 



5. Daily Operational Oversight 



Conduct structured reviews throughout the day: 



Morning: Overnight activity and urgent issues 



Midday: Communication queue and active items 



End of day: Next-day readiness and unresolved issues 



Ensure no critical issues are missed 



Maintain operational awareness without constant real-time monitoring

Flag opportunities for improvement to leadership 



Perform occasional proactive client check-ins when appropriate 



7. System Updates & Documentation 



Maintain accurate records in WellSky: 



Notes.  



Transferring notes over from Phoebe 



Client and caregiver updates 



Relevant operational details 



Ensure documentation is clear, complete, and timely 



Work Structure 



This is a full-day role operating within a structured workflow, not continuous real-time response. 



Work is completed through: 



Priority handling (urgent items addressed immediately) 



Scheduled callback and follow-up blocks 



End-of-day operational review 



 



Qualifications 



Experience in home care, scheduling, or operations support preferred

Strong communication and problem-solving skills  



Highly organized and detail-oriented  



Ability to prioritize and work independently  



Calm and professional under pressure

title: Auto Transport Operations Coordinator (Remote – Philippines)
description:
Location: Remote – Philippines Hours: Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time (full-time, ~40 hrs/week) 



Pay: $3–$4 USD/hour base + commission per booked load (structure discussed during interview) Employment Type: Full-time / Contract About the Role



TrueTruck Auto Transport is a US-based auto transport brokerage. We connect customers who need to ship vehicles with the carriers who move them, and we built this company on a simple idea: be honest with customers, every single time. That means accurate quotes, real timelines, and no games. It's how we want every conversation to sound.



We're looking for a sharp, motivated coordinator to handle the day-to-day communication that keeps shipments moving — talking and texting with customers, working leads, negotiating with carriers, and posting loads on the major dispatch boards. 



This is a hands-on operations role where you'll wear several hats and have a direct impact on whether a load gets booked, dispatched, and delivered cleanly.



You don't need prior auto transport experience. We'll train you on everything. What we need is excellent English, quick thinking, and someone who can hold their own on the phone and over text.



What You'll Do



- Respond to inbound customer leads via phone and text — quote shipments, explain the process, and book the job

- Handle a high volume of text message conversations with customers, leads, carriers, and drivers throughout the day

- Cold call leads when other work is quiet (this is a steady part of the role, not the main focus, but it matters)

- Communicate with existing customers — provide updates, answer questions, handle issues professionally

- Post loads on Super Dispatch and Central Dispatch

- Negotiate rates with carriers and dispatchers to get loads moved at the right price

- Verify carrier insurance and authority before dispatching

- Coordinate with carriers and drivers throughout pickup and delivery — confirm details, troubleshoot delays, keep everyone on the same page

- Keep our internal CRM up to date with accurate notes on every customer, lead, and load

- Flag problems early — a late driver, a customer concern, a carrier that won't pick up the phone



What We're Looking For

- This role requires real-time thinking on the phone and clear, professional writing over text. You'll be talking to US customers who want clear answers, texting back and forth with leads who are comparing quotes and negotiating with carriers who push hard on rates. You need to:

 - Listen carefully, respond clearly, and not get rattled

 - Write quick, professional text messages with correct grammar and a natural American tone

 - Stay honest with customers even when it's not what they want to hear — it's how we operate

 - Push back politely but firmly when a carrier's rate doesn't work

 - Juggle multiple shipments and text threads at different stages without dropping the ball



Requirements



- Excellent written and spoken English — near-native fluency, minimal accent, clean writing

- Able to think and respond on your feet during live phone calls

- Fast, accurate typing — a lot of this job is texting

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

- Comfortable on the phone — this is a phone-heavy and text-heavy role

- Comfortable using basic computer tools:
, messaging apps, CRM software

- Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time, consistently

- Responsive during your shift



Preferred (Not Required)

- Prior experience in auto transport, logistics, freight brokerage, or dispatch

- Sales, cold calling, or call center experience

- Customer service experience with US customers

- Familiarity with Super Dispatch, Central Dispatch, or any TMS/CRM software



We provide the phone system, software access, and training. You bring the work ethic and the English.



What We Offer

- Full-time, consistent hours with a stable US-based company

- Base pay plus commission on every load you book — the more you close, the more you earn

- Real training on the auto transport industry, not just a script

- Direct communication with a small team — you'll know who you're working with

- Long-term role for the right person

Applications without a personal message will not be considered.

description:

We're not hiring someone to close tickets and clock out. We're hiring a killer CS agent who treats our support operation like it's their own business. If you read job posts looking for "tasks" and "responsibilities" to tick off — close this one. If you read them looking for an operation you can take ownership of and grow inside of, keep reading.



We run a 6–7 figure multi-brand e-commerce operation spanning 5 stores across the EU and US markets. We move fast, we scale hard, and we're building a backend team that runs like a machine. You'll join a backend team of 7 and work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Supply Chain Manager, Backend Manager, Dispute Manager, and CS team.



What this role actually is

This is a CS Agent role : high-ownership one. You'll be on the frontline of our support operation across all stores. (Got management experience? Even better : there's real room to grow here if your performance is good for 2 months. But make no mistake: this role is about being an elite agent first.)



This is not a "follow the SOP and wait for instructions" role. This is a "I saw a problem three steps before anyone asked, and I fixed it" role.



The single most important thing we're looking for

Ownership. You don't just clear your queue — you look beyond your own lane, spot problems early (refunds, fulfillment delays, chargebacks, disputes), and get ahead of them. Proactivity and work ethic rank above everything else. Show us that, and you get paid extremely well for it.



What you'll own

Edit long-form YouTube videos from raw multi-cam footage

Build retention-focused edits: strong cold opens, pacing, pattern interrupts, no dead air

Create motion graphics and animations that lift the edit, not just plain text on screen

Rotoscoping and masking work where the edit calls for it

Sound design: build atmosphere, punch, and polish, not just drop in a track

Music selection that fits the tone and drives pacing

Sync audio, clean up sound, colour correction

Work to briefs and packaging direction (we'll tell you the angle, you make it land)

Handle revisions and hit deadlines consistently

Strong motion graphics and animation skills (this is not a basic-level requirement, we want to see real quality)

Rotoscoping and masking ability

Sound design skills, not just adding background music

Music selection with a good ear for tone and pacing

A real understanding of YouTube pacing and retention (not just corporate/wedding editing)

Good written English and clear communication

Reliable, deadline-driven, self-managing

Your own editing setup and stable internet



Nice to have



Fitness, gym, or coaching content experience

After Effects proficiency

Thumbnail design

Ability to self-direct an edit from a loose brief



Hours & Availability



Full-time, 40 hours per week

UK time zone availability is essential. You'll need solid overlap with UK hours as communication is a big part of this role

100% remote



Salary



Competitive: PHP 50,000 to 85,000 per month, depending on experience and skillset

Long-term, ongoing role with room to grow



How to apply

Links to 2 to 3 long-form YouTube videos you've edited (tell us what you did on each, and point out any motion graphics, rotoscoping, or sound design you did yourself)

title: Product Developer of Small Leather Goods
description:
Leather Goods Product Developer & Sample Maker

Remote (Outside the United States) | Illustrator + Hands-On Leather Sample Making

Engagement: Ongoing monthly retainer, with flexibility to structure as per-piece or hourly for a paid trial project



About the Role

We're a small leather goods brand looking for a hands-on product developer to help us design and prototype new styles faster and at lower cost. You'll take rough concepts (sketches, references, or verbal descriptions), your own ideas/thoughts, and turn them into finished physical samples and clean, print-ready pattern files. This is a great fit for someone who genuinely enjoys making things with their hands and also knows their way around Adobe Illustrator.

Your samples and files will be used to produce cutting files for our digital dieless cutting machine (Atom Flash Cut), so precision and clean vector work matter as much as good craftsmanship.

What You'll Do

• Develop new small leather goods styles from a brief, sketch, or reference photo — examples of the product categories we work in: bifold/trifold wallets, card holders, valet trays, keychains/key fobs, sunglass cases, and various other small leather goods.

• Hand-make (or machine-stitch) physical prototype samples in your own home workshop or office space, iterating on fit, proportions, and construction until the design is right.

• Create clean, accurate flat pattern pieces in Adobe Illustrator for every approved sample — correct seam allowances, notches, fold lines, and stitch lines included.

• Package each finished style with a simple written or photographed construction guide (step-by-step assembly instructions) that another maker could follow without you present.

• Recommend leather weights, hardware, and construction methods appropriate for each product type and cost target.

• Communicate clearly and proactively about timelines, material sourcing, and any design trade-offs.

What We'll Provide

• Design briefs, references, and dimensions for each new style.

• Scope and criteria for what makes a successful product.

• Feedback rounds on samples and files before final approval.

• Reimbursement for reasonable material costs on approved development projects (agreed in advance).

What We're Looking For

• Hands-on experience making small leather goods — not just larger bags. Portfolio should show items like wallets, valet trays, keychains, card cases, or sunglass cases.

• Comfortable working with vegetable-tanned or chrome-tanned leather, skiving, edge finishing/burnishing, and hand or machine stitching.

• Working proficiency in Adobe Illustrator — able to build accurate flat patterns and vector line art from a physical sample or sketch.

• Your own dedicated space to work (home workshop, garage, or small studio/office) with basic leathercraft tools already on hand.

• Based outside the United States, with reliable internet access for video calls and file sharing.

• Strong attention to detail — precise measurements matter since your patterns feed directly into automated cutting.

• Good written English for briefs, feedback, and instructions.

• Familiarity with common leather hardware (snaps, rivets, zippers, D-rings).

• 

Nice to Have

• Experience preparing files for laser or dieless cutting systems.

• Prior experience working with overseas/remote brands.

How to Apply

Please include: (1) photos of 3–5 small leather goods you've personally made — wallets, valet trays, keychains, or sunglass cases are examples; (2) a short note on your Illustrator experience and workspace/tool setup; (3) your availability and preferred rate structure (monthly, hourly, or per-piece).

We're looking to start with a small paid trial project (one style, sample-to-pattern-file) before moving to an ongoing monthly arrangement.

title: Email Graphic Designer (Figma) - Part-Time to Full-Time

This is a firm, experience-required role. We are not training beginners on this one. If you don't have a real
 design portfolio, please don't apply.



About Us



We're a small, boutique
 marketing agency working with ecommerce and DTC brands. Right now the core team is just two of us, and we're building deliberately. Our long-term model is to run in pods (account manager, graphic designer, copywriter, and
 builder per 5-10 clients) as we grow, but today it's lean: you, the founder, and a dedicated
