That means this isn't a "slot into an existing machine" job. You'll have real input into how the design process works as we scale, and you'll be one of the first hires as we build toward the full pod structure.



The Role



We need a proper graphic designer, someone who lives in Figma and can design scroll-stopping, on-brand
 templates for ecommerce clients. This is not a "drag and drop template" job. You'll be designing the actual visual layout, hierarchy, and style of campaign and flow
s from scratch, working from brand guidelines, past campaigns, and direct creative direction from the founder (until we bring on dedicated copywriters and account managers).



You will NOT be doing the Klaviyo/Omnisend build or scheduling, that's handled by our dedicated
 builder. Your job is the design file. Clean, well-organized Figma work that a builder can pick up and slice without guesswork.



What You'll Be Doing



Designing
 campaigns and flow templates in Figma (product launches, promos, custom
 flow build outs etc.)

Maintaining brand consistency across multiple client accounts

Organizing Figma files cleanly (proper naming, layers, components) so builders can hand off quickly

Working from copy provided to make sure design supports the hierarchy (subject, header, CTA, body)

Adapting design systems for different brand aesthetics, this isn't one-size-fits-all

Occasionally designing supporting assets (banners, popups, social-to
 crossovers)





What We're Looking For





Strong portfolio of
 design work (ecommerce/DTC experience is a must)

Confident, fast in Figma, including components, auto-layout, and organized file structure

Understanding of
 design constraints (safe widths, mobile-first thinking, basic accessibility like contrast and font sizing) 

A good eye for hierarchy, typography, and brand adaptation, not just "pretty," but effective

Comfortable taking creative direction and revising based on feedback

Reliable communicator, comfortable with async updates and occasional live check-ins

Bonus: experience working in an agency or pod-style team setup





Why Join Us





Clear path from part-time to full-time within a few months as we onboard more clients

Ground-floor opportunity, you'll be one of our first three hires, with real potential to grow into a lead design role as we scale toward our pod model

Varied work across multiple ecommerce brands, not stuck designing for one repetitive style

Direct access to the founder, no layers of middle management, fast feedback, fast decisions





How to Apply

title: Account Director
description:
About the Role



A growing boutique recruiting and RPO firm is expanding its team. We build dedicated recruiting programs for clients across healthcare, insurance, and sales, and we are hiring an Account Director to help lead delivery and grow our recruiting team.



Working alongside the firm's Principal, who serves as the primary client contact, you will help lead the recruiting effort, step in to run client calls when she is unavailable, and drive consistent monthly candidate delivery. This is a hands-on leadership role: part team leader, part mentor, part delivery engine, and part recruiter. You lead and develop the team, keep the pipeline full, and roll up your sleeves to source and screen candidates yourself.



What You Will Do

? Recruit hands-on yourself, sourcing, screening, and managing candidates directly alongside the team rather than only overseeing it.

?Lead and mentor a team of recruiters and sourcers, providing day-to-day coaching, feedback, and hands-on development to help each person grow.

? Set clear goals and performance targets for the team, track progress against them, run regular check-ins, and keep everyone accountable to delivery.

? Build a positive, high-performing team culture, developing skills, sharing best practices, and raising the bar over time.

? Support the client relationship as a trusted backup, leading cadence calls and client updates when the Principal is unavailable and keeping stakeholders confident and informed.

? Drive delivery against monthly candidate targets across multiple US markets, ensuring a consistent, predictable flow of qualified candidates.

? Design and continuously refine sourcing strategy and target lists for each market.

? Safeguard candidate quality, making sure every hand-off is genuinely pre-screened and finalist-ready.

? Track and report metrics such as submittals, pipeline health, and time-to-slate, and translate them into clear updates.



What You Bring

? Strong, hands-on recruiting experience, with a proven track record recruiting for the US market and the ability to source and screen candidates yourself.

? Team leadership and mentorship experience, having led, coached, and developed a team of recruiters or sourcers and set goals that drive performance.

? Client-facing experience managing external client relationships and senior stakeholders, and comfort representing the firm on calls.

? Large-account experience, having owned a high-volume account or requisition load and delivered against targets.

? Excellent written and spoken English and a polished, professional communication style.

? Ability to work US business hours (EST) from the Philippines.

? Comfort with ATS/CRM systems, sourcing tools, and reporting.



Nice to Have

? Healthcare, insurance, or sales recruiting background.

? RPO or staffing-agency experience.

? High-volume or multi-market recruiting experience.



Why This Role

This is a leadership seat on a high-visibility account with a growing firm. You will have real ownership of a flagship engagement, direct partnership with the founder, and the chance to grow as the account and the business scale.

Remote, Full-Time, Philippines



We are an established Australian commercial furniture brand supplying the hospitality industry, including restaurants, hotels, bars, clubs and commercial projects.



We work with overseas factories, Australian designers, architects, hospitality operators and trade clients. We are a small team and need a smart, organised coordinator to take ownership of sales administration and marketing execution.



This is not a basic VA role. We need someone who can think, write clearly, use technology well, and push back when something does not make sense.

- Respond to inbound customer
s professionally and quickly

 marketing operations, including database uploads, list cleaning, segmentation, scheduling and sending campaigns

 deliverability and flag list-quality issues before campaigns are sent

mbers

- Marketing or IT background, either through study or work experience

- Strong written English suitable for Australian business customers

- Comfortable using technology, spreadsheets, AI tools, web admin systems and social media tools

- Able to learn platforms such as Magento, Shopify, Odoo, Gmail workflows,
 marketing tools and social scheduling tools

- Practical social media experience for business pages, not just personal posting

- Basic design sense is desirable, especially around image quality, clean layout, product presentation, Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign or similar tools

- Independent thinker who can question instructions and suggest better ways to work

- Organised, reliable and comfortable working with a small business team

- Available 10am to 5pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday



Preferred background:

Experience in commercial furniture, hospitality fit-out, interiors, FF&E, joinery, trade supply, visual merchandising, product marketing or design support is preferred.



We are also open to candidates from related B2B industries such as building products, commercial equipment, wholesale/import, hospitality suppliers, construction suppliers or trade services.

Make "teak" the first word of your application.

1. Give one real example where you disagreed with the person paying you, told them so, and what came of it.

 Apply here: 
 



At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions—we build lasting, impactful careers. As a Remote Data Activator, you’ll serve as a dedicated sales support engine for U.S.-based moving companies by unlocking revenue from untapped seller data provided by USA Home Listings (Tier 2). This is not an admin or back-office role—your job is to drive action and revenue through strategic outbound communication.



The Data Activator’s core mission is simple: turn overlooked homeowner data into booked moving estimates and referral opportunities. You’ll use a proven outreach playbook to connect with sellers, engage realtors, and drive measurable value directly into your client’s sales pipeline.







Why Join Ready Roles?



A Career Path, Not Just a Job: This role is designed for growth-minded professionals who want to contribute directly to revenue outcomes and be seen as an essential part of a business’s sales process.

Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients: You’ll support clients who are ready to invest in outbound efforts and value performance-driven tea
mbers who help them win.







Key Responsibilities:



1. Lead Activation & Seller Outreach



Conduct daily outbound texting to homeowners using USA Home Listings (Tier 2 data).

Monitor seller responsiveness and tailor outreach cadence to maximize conversion.

4. Booking & Scheduling

Ensure appointment details are accurate and the client is notified promptly.

Provide clear, consistent updates on progress and performance.

Familiarity with outbound messaging, CRM tools, and scheduling software.

Organized and self-motivated with a strong sense of accountability.

A quick learner who can follow scripts, iterate when needed, and identify high-converting patterns.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer & Graphic Designer
description:
About Us

The Social Studio is a UK-based content agency. We build and run YouTube channels for established fitness coaches and creators, everything from IFBB Pro athletes to online business mentors. We're not chasing generic "content." We care about packaging, click-through, and thumbnails that actually earn the click. We're looking for a long-term designer to join the team as our roster grows.

The Role

You'll be designing high-performing YouTube thumbnails that stop the scroll and drive clicks, plus supporting graphic design across our channels (channel art, banners, and other brand assets). This is a packaging role. We don't want someone who just knows Photoshop. We want someone who understands why a thumbnail gets clicked.

What you'll do



Design scroll-stopping YouTube thumbnails that drive click-through

Work title and thumbnail together as a package, not in isolation

Create channel art, banners, and other brand graphics as needed

Produce clean composites: cut-outs, retouching, colour work, text treatment

Match and evolve each client's visual style while keeping it consistent

Work to briefs and packaging direction from our team

Iterate based on feedback and performance

Deliver consistently and on time



Requirements



Proven YouTube thumbnail portfolio (this is essential, no portfolio means no reply)

Expert-level Photoshop skills

Strong compositing: clean cut-outs, retouching, colour correction, lighting

A real eye for click psychology and visual hierarchy (what the eye lands on first and why)

Understanding of title and thumbnail synergy

Solid general graphic design ability for channel art and brand assets

Good written English and clear communication

Reliable, deadline-driven, self-managing

Your own setup and stable internet



Nice to have



Fitness, gym, or coaching content experience

Illustrator and After Effects

Experience designing for personal brands or creators

Familiarity with YouTube analytics and CTR



Hours & Availability



Output-based role: we care about quality and consistency, not clocking hours

Flexible working, but you'll need reasonable overlap with UK hours for communication

100% remote

Long-term, ongoing



Salary



Competitive: PHP 25,000 to 45,000 per month, depending on experience and skillset. 

Long-term role with room to grow



How to apply

Please send:



Link to your thumbnail portfolio, and name the actual channels your thumbnails are live on (public links, not just image files)

Evidence of performance. Ideally analytics screenshots (impressions and CTR), or public view counts on videos you packaged. Tell us what was yours: the full thumbnail, the concept, or part of a team

Pick one of your thumbnails and explain in a sentence or two why it works

We run paid test edits as part of our process, so be ready for a short brief

Start your application with the word PACKAGING so we know you actually read this



Applications without a portfolio, real channel links, or the codeword will be ignored.

title: Service Delivery Manager (Global, Remote)
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RESUME LINK 



Job description:



Service Delivery Manager (Global, Remote)



Tech Guru | IT strategy, security & support for accounting firms | Full-time, remote, US Central 9 AM to 5 PM with occasional after-hours i
 response



Who we are



Tech Guru has served accounting and CPA firms exclusively since 2004. We handle technology strategy, security, and support for about 60 firms across the US and Canada, and our plan is 500 firms by 2030. We run on EOS. We are a 20-person global virtual team, profitable, growing, and serious about quality. Our promise to clients is simple: we care about your business as much as you do. Our guarantee is simpler: love it or you don't pay.



We live four values and we actually use them to hire, review, and part ways: Caring, Accountable, Responsive, Empathetic.



Why this role exists



We grew. Our delivery teams got busy. Quality slipped in ways that cost us money and, worse, cost us client trust. We fixed the immediate problems and built a change control system, but systems only work when someone owns them every single day. That someone is you.



This is a new seat. You will report directly to the CEO and take over daily leadership of our Support, Project Management, and Deployment teams. Your job is to make our delivery so consistent and so well-measured that the CEO never learns about a problem from a client.



Mission



Lead Tech Guru's service delivery teams to deliver every ticket, project, and onboarding on time and to standard, with zero avoidable client-impacting errors, while protecting our service margins as we grow.



Outcomes (what success looks like in your first 12 months)



Change control compliance reaches 100% within 90 days and stays there. Every high-risk change goes through the documented approval workflow in HaloPSA. Avoidable client-impacting errors (data loss, misconfigured mail flow, unauthorized changes) drop to zero and stay there.

Scheduled service delivery hits 95%+ on-time within 6 months. Tickets meet SLA, scheduled service calls happen when promised, and the schedule maintains 24/7 coverage without heroics.

Projects deliver 90%+ on time and on budget by month 9. You own the project management function, including running it hands-on until you hire or develop a project manager, and every project closes with a retrospective that feeds a process improvement.

Client onboardings complete within our published timeline, every time. New client and new user onboarding becomes a repeatable, documented, delightful experience measured by client feedback scores.

Escalations reaching the CEO drop below one per week by month 6. You become the person who owns i
 end to end: containment, client communication, root cause, and the fix that prevents recurrence.

Managed services contribution margin holds at 49%+ while client count grows. You know your team's utilization, cost per ticket, and rework rate cold, and you report them on a scorecard weekly.

Your team gets stronger. Every direct report has a scorecard, a weekly meeting rhythm, a documented career path, and honest quarterly conversations. Regrettable attrition on your teams: zero.

Competencies (how you work)



You lead managers and technicians, and you love it. You have led service delivery, support, or NOC teams of 5+ people, ideally at an MSP. You would rather build a team that solves problems than solve them all yourself.

Process discipline is your native language. You have built or enforced change management, QA, or ITIL-style processes and made them stick under pressure. You know that a process that erodes when things get busy is not a process.

You run on data. PSA metrics, SLA reports, utilization, margin. You bring numbers to every conversation and you notice drift before it becomes a pattern.

High emotional intelligence under pressure. When something breaks, you call the client before they call us, you say what happened plainly, and you rebuild trust. You coach your team to do the same.

You root out ambiguity. You ask the second and third question. You confirm what you heard before acting. You push back respectfully when a request is not actually in the requester's best interest.

Direct, kind, and honest. You give real feedback early. You own mistakes without drama and expect the same from your team.

Bonus, not required: HaloPSA experience, EOS/Traction familiarity, exposure to the accounting industry or its applications (Lacerte, UltraTax, Drake, CCH), Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, experience leading distributed global teams.

Roles and Responsibilities



Team Leadership



Directly manage the Support, Project Management, and Deployment team leads/managers, with full oversight of scheduling, workload distribution, and 24/7 coverage.

Run a weekly meeting rhythm with each direct report, including a scorecard review and a Level 10-style tea
eting for the broader delivery org.

Change Management & Quality



Own and enforce the change control workflow in HaloPSA, ensuring every high-risk change is documented, approved, and logged before execution.

Conduct regular audits of completed changes and tickets to catch process drift before it becomes a pattern.

Investigate any client-impacting error to root cause and implement the fix that prevents recurrence, not just the immediate patch.

Service Delivery Operations



Monitor SLA compliance, ticket aging, and scheduled service calls daily, intervening before targets are missed rather than after.

Maintain and report a weekly scorecard covering utilization, rework rate, and contribution margin.

Manage the on-call/escalation rotation and serve as the point of ownership for any i
 that would otherwise reach the CEO.

Project Management



Provide direct oversight of the Project Management function, including the PM's workload, prioritization, and adherence to timelines and budgets.

Partner with the PM to ensure every project has a defined scope, timeline, and budget, and closes with a retrospective that feeds into process improvement.

Track project portfolio health across all active projects and flag at-risk projects early to the CEO

Client Onboarding



Own the new client and new user onboarding process end to end, ensuring it's documented, repeatable, and measured by client feedback.

Continuously refine the onboarding experience based on feedback scores and internal retrospectives.

Client & I
 Communication



Serve as the escalation point for client-impacting issues, communicating proactively (before the client has to reach out) and transparently.

Rebuild client trust after i
 through clear post-mortems and visible corrective action.

Cross-Functional Reporting



Report weekly to the CEO on delivery metrics, margin, escalations, and team health.

Flag systemic risks (staffing gaps, recurring error patterns, margin erosion) before they become CEO-level problems.

What this role is not



This is not a senior tech role with a manager title attached. If your favorite part of the week is closing tickets yourself, you will be frustrated here and this is not a caretaker role. We are growing fast and the bar is rising every quarter.



Compensation and setup



Salary range: depends on location and experience

Fully remote, work from anywhere with reliable internet

A team that is genuinely kind, direct, and proud of the work

Benefits:





Promotion to permanent employee

Work from home

Application Question(s):





Describe a process you built or fixed that was still working after you stopped actively managing it. What was the before, the after, and the metric that proved it?

What's your notice period?

What's your salary expectation?

What's your experience working with distributed, global teams across multiple time zones?

Experience:





Service Delivery Manager: 5 years (Required)

Leadership: 5 years (Required)

MSP: 5 years (Required)

SLA Management : 3 years (Required)

title: Weekend Care Operations Oversight
description:
The Weekend Care Operations Oversight role provides structured, limited support on Saturdays and Sundays to ensure continuity of care, timely handling of urgent issues, and proper follow-up on outstanding items from the prior day. 



This is a part-time, on-call role designed to support operations alongside automated systems (Phoebe, HelloSells, WellSky). Scheduling, call-outs, and inbound communication are primarily handled by these systems. 



The role focuses on: 



Reviewing system activity  



Handling urgent escalations  



Closing open loops from prior days  



Ensuring readiness for the next day  



This role requires a high level of comfort with technology. The individual will actively manage and monitor Phoebe (AI scheduling system), interpret system alerts, and take action when human intervention is required. 



Schedule & Time Commitment 



This role operates in three structured blocks per day: 



Morning Block: Review overnight activity and urgent issues  



Midday Block: Check active coverage and address escalations  



Evening Block: Close the day and prepare for the next day  



Total Time Commitment: 

Approximately 4–6 hours per weekend day 



Outside of these blocks, the role is not actively working, but may respond to true urgent escalations if necessary. 



 



Core Responsibilities 



1. Daily System Review 



During each scheduled block, review: 



Phoebe activity (shift coverage, call-outs, alerts)  



HelloSells messages and tagged calls  



Open issues from the prior day  



Ensure all critical items are identified and addressed. 



 



2. Escalation Management 



Respond to urgent issues requiring human intervention, including: 



Unfilled shifts after system attempts  



Caregiver no-shows or late arrivals  



Client concerns impacting active care  



Same day or next day new client coverage  



Take appropriate action and ensure timely communication. 



 



3. Client Communication (Urgent Only) 



Communicate with clients when care is impacted 



Provide updates regarding: 



Late caregivers  



Call-outs  



Coverage status  



 



4. Close the Loop 



Follow up on: 



Issues from the previous day  



Open items flagged by the weekday team  



Ensure issues are resolved or clearly documented 



 



5. End-of-Day Control 



Confirm next-day readiness: 



Coverage gaps  



Known risks or concerns  



Document and communicate to Executive Director any unresolved items for weekday follow-up 



Qualifications 



Experience in home care, scheduling, or operations support preferred  



Tech-savvy with the ability to confidently use and manage systems such as Phoebe (AI scheduling), WellSky, and communication platforms  



Strong communication and problem-solving skills  



Highly organized and detail-oriented  



Ability to prioritize and work independently  



Calm and professional under pressure  



 



Work Schedule 



Remote | EST Hours 



Saturday & Sunday: 

10–12 hours total for the weekend 



8:00am-10:00am

1:00am-3:00pm

7:00pm-9:00pm

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer (Remote)

description:
Summary

Part-time or full-time virtual assistant with experience sending photos to clients, editing/fixing photos and videos of houses for real estate.



What a typical day may look like:

1) Submit photos to AutoHDR from Dropbox (our photographers upload at the end of the day Toronto time.

2) Make sure the photos look good and make any necessary adjustments to fix the photos either in Lightroom or within AutoHDR.

3) upload photos to Aryeo (platform to send media to real estate agents) and send to clients.

4) review videos from our editing team in Vietnam, provide feedback and revision to our Vietnam team if there are any glitches or fixes needing to be made.

5) upload final video to Aryeo to send to our clients (same listing portal as photos)

6) the above should take up most of the day, if there is extra time (especially in slower seasons), assist with our marketing and social media and other administrative tasks.



About the Company

We are a growing real estate media company based in Canada. We provide high-quality photography, videography, and marketing content for real estate agents. We need a reliable Media Editor & QC Virtual Assistant who can work while we sleep so listings are ready for our North American clients in the morning.



Photos Quality Assurance

We use AutoHDR for our photo editing. Sometimes the program makes mistakes and we need someone with a good eye and attention to detail to make those fixes before sending to the client.



Video Quality Assurance

We have a separate video editing vendor in Vietnam, you would review the videos and provide any feedback and fixes to our video editing team or be able to make simple fixes yourself.



Job Responsibilities

- Edit and enhance real estate photos (straightening slanted/horizontal lines, exposure, white balance, composition improvements, lens correction, etc.).

- Perform quality control on photos and ensure professional standards for composition, lighting, and overall appeal.

- Use AutoHDR and/or Lightroom for photo editing and fixes.

- Review video tours edited by our team in Vietnam using Final Cut Pro. Make minor fixes (color, cuts, stabilization, etc.) or provide clear revision notes to the editor if major changes are needed.

- Deliver completed media packages through Aryeo to clients.

- Maintain consistent brand standards and meet tight deadlines.



Requirements

- Proven experience editing real estate photos with a strong eye for composition, lighting, and fixing slanted/horizontal images.

- Experience delivering media through Aryeo.

- Comfortable using (or quick to learn) AutoHDR for photo enhancement.

- Proficient in Final Cut Pro for basic video fixes and QC.

- Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).

- High-speed, stable internet connection with reliable power backup (no frequent outages) — this is critical as tasks are urgent and time-sensitive.

- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.



Big advantage if you have:

• Previous experience working with North American or Canadian real estate media companies.

• Fast turnaround and strong attention to detail under deadline pressure.



What We Offer:

• Competitive hourly rate with long-term opportunity with a growing company.

• Clear training, SOPs, and Loom videos for our exact workflow.



Your resume/CV:

- experience related to this position

- Short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

- Your experience with Aryeo, AutoHDR, Lightroom, and Final Cut Pro.

- Why you’re a good fit for real estate media delivery, quality assurance and editing.



Working during your day while it is our night time:

Your availability working during the day in your time zone. Our timezone is Toronto
 Time and it would be preferred that while it is our night that you are working with our video editing vendor in Vietnam and preparing photos to send to clients during the day in Philippine or similar time zone.

title: Chat Intake Training Manager
description:
About Juvo Leads

Juvo Leads is one of the fastest-growing live chat and legal intake companies in the United States. For more than 11 years, we have helped law firms connect with prospective clients through live chat, inbound call handling, appointment scheduling, and intake services.



Our primary focus is serving law firms nationwide, helping them create exceptional first impressions and convert more qualified prospects into clients.



While much of the industry continues to move toward automation, AI, and chatbots, our philosophy remains simple:

Butts in Seats. Not Bots in the Cloud.



We believe that when someone is searching for legal help, they deserve to interact with a real person. Every conversation we handle is powered by a trained human tea
mber—not artificial intelligence. Our commitment to genuine human interaction is what sets us apart and has fueled our growth for more than a decade.



As we continue to expand, we're building a world-class remote workforce capable of delivering exceptional service at scale. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about developing people, improving performance, and creating systems that help employees succeed.



If you're excited about building high-performing remote teams, developing talent, and creating measurable business impact through training and coaching, we'd love to meet you.



Overview

We are seeking a Training Manager to own the onboarding, development, certification, and ongoing education of our remote chat agent workforce. This role is responsible for ensuring every new hire receives a consistent, high-quality training experience and is fully prepared to succeed in production.



The Training Manager will design and deliver training programs, oversee agent readiness, partner with Operations and Quality teams to address performance gaps, and continuously improve learning initiatives that drive quality, efficiency, and client outcomes. This position is accountable not only for training delivery, but for the measurable success of agents after training.



The ideal candidate has experience building and managing remote training programs, coaching adult learners, developing curriculum, and creating scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth.



 Key Responsibilities: 



New Hire Training & Onboarding

  * Own the end-to-end onboarding and training experience for all new chat agents.

  * Design and deliver structured onboarding programs that prepare agents for legal intake and live chat responsibilities.

  * Ensure all new hires complete training, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * Conduct readiness assessments and certify agents before transition to production teams.

  * Facilitate seamless handoffs between Training, Operations, and Quality teams.



Training Program Development

  * Design, implement, and continuously improve training programs for new and existing agents.

  * Develop lesson plans, training materials, SOPs, assessments, simulations, certifications, and knowledge base content.

  * Ensure training content remains current, accurate, and aligned with operational processes and client requirements.

  * Create scalable training systems capable of supporting company growth and new client launches.

  * Incorporate adult learning principles and instructional design best practices into all training initiatives.



Coaching & Employee Development

  * Deliver engaging virtual training sessions using a variety of learning methods and technologies.

  * Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental feedback to employees throughout their tenure.

  * Partner with supervisors to identify employee skill gaps and create targeted development plans.

  * Build refresher training, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.

  * Support career growth initiatives, internal promotions, and leadership development pathways.



Performance Assessment & Quality Improvement

  * Develop evaluation tools to measure trainee comprehension, readiness, and performance.

  * Track post-training performance to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Analyze quality trends, recurring errors, and operational performance metrics to identify training opportunities.

  * Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to reduce performance gaps and improve outcomes.

  * Ensure retraining initiatives are deployed quickly when performance concerns emerge. 



Collaboration & Program Management

  * Partner closely with Operations Leadership, Quality Assurance, and Client Services teams.

title: Short-Form AI UGC Video Editor (Base + Uncapped Performance Bonuses)
description:
Read this WHOLE post before applying. This is a performance role, not a flat-wage role. If you want a comfortable fixed salary, this is not for you. If you want to out-earn one, keep reading.



WHAT YOU EARN (read this first)



This is the headline, so we lead with it.





Base: $200/mo, guaranteed, paid for clearing a minimum weekly output bar. This is a floor, not the target. Treat it as the smallest number you can earn, NOT the number you are aiming for.

Performance bonuses stack on top, tied to the metrics we actually track: view tiers per video, hook rate, and average watch time. Higher view tiers earn more. Better hooks and retention earn more.

Monthly leaderboard bonus for the top editor.

Realistic top-performer earnings: $900 to $1,200/mo, and uncapped above that for genuine standouts.





Pay scales with performance, full stop. Mediocre editors earn little here. Great editors out-earn a standard flat editor salary. That is the deal.



THE WORK





Produce short-form vertical videos (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) for an in-house adult audio brand in the dark romance / spicy audiobook space.

High volume: baseline is about 180 edits per month, roughly 6 per day, 7 days a week (about 40 finished edits per week).

Every edit is hook-first, subtitled and captioned, and trend-aware.





THE CONTENT (be honest with yourself here)



The product is a mature, adult audio brand (dark romance). Content is suggestive, never explicit. That is a hard rule and it does not change.

You will work with adult, romance, and mature-themed material every single day.

Apply only if you are genuinely comfortable with this. Do not accept and then quit two weeks in over the subject matter. Screen yourself now.





HOW YOU GET CUT (equally important, read it)



We cut low performers fast. That is the whole reason the ceiling for top performers is high.



We d
 in or out from your portfolio. Weak samples, no trial.

Once you are in, you can be out the next day.

Named triggers, no ambiguity: miss the weekly output bar 2 times, or finish bottom of the performance leaderboard for 2 consecutive weeks, and the contract ends. Immediately.





If you are hungry, this is opportunity: dead weight gets cleared, so your ceiling is not capped by someone coasting next to you. If that makes you nervous, this is not your role.



REQUIREMENTS





Fluent short-form editing in CapCut or equivalent.

Strong hook instinct (you know what stops a scroll in the first 2 seconds).

Solid subtitle and caption work.

Real trend awareness across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

Comfort using AI tooling.

Reliable computer and internet.

Capacity for genuine daily high-volume output.

Real comfort with adult romance / mature content.

18 or older (adult content).





HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly, we filter hard)



Applications that skip any step are deleted unread.





Start your reply with the exact phrase: HOOK FIRST. If it is missing, we skip you.

Link a portfolio, or attach 2 to 3 sample short-form edits.

State your realistic daily edit capacity (honest number).

State your fastest honest turnaround per video.

Answer plainly, yes or no: are you comfortable working with adult, dark romance audio content daily?





We reply fast to strong applicants. Show us hooks.

title: Short-form video editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor — Ongoing Series (Part-Time)



Job Description:

We're producing a short-form video series for my videos.



I need a video editor who can turn raw footage and a detailed editing brief into punchy, engaging 30–60 second videos for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What you'll be working with:



I'll send you raw video (shot on iPhone, to-camera) plus a written brief for every episode. The brief tells you ideas of what happens at each timestamp — where to cut, where to punch-in zoom, where B-roll goes, what on-screen captions to add, and when. Your job is to execute that brief with skill, add your own creative touches where it makes sense, and make it feel polished without overproducing it.



What the videos look like:



Clean, minimal, engaging. Think dry humour, sharp cuts, and well-timed captions — not flashy transitions or heavy effects. The energy comes from pacing and edit timing, not motion graphics. Captions on screen throughout. Subtle sound design welcome. Background music track (I'll provide or you source from royalty-free libraries).



The edit style in detail:



Punch-in zooms for emphasis (simple crop reframes, not animated). Quick B-roll cutaways over voiceover. Rapid-fire insert shots (phone screens, Slack messages, business cards). On-screen text — clean sans-serif, white, hard cut on/off, no bouncing or sliding animations. Music that builds subtly and drops out at key 
nts. Comfortable pacing — not frantic, not slow.



What I'm looking for:



Experience editing short-form vertical video (Reels, Shorts, TikTok). Strong sense of timing and pacing — you know when to cut and when to let a 
nt breathe. Clean caption/text work. Able to take a detailed brief and execute it precisely, while also knowing when to add something I didn't think of. Reliable turnaround — I'll need episodes back within 24 hours of sending footage.



Software: CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut — whatever you use is fine as long as the output is right.

This is a paid test first. I'll send you raw footage and the editing brief for Episode 1. You edit it. If the quality is right, this becomes ongoing work — 2 to 4 videos per week across the series.



Hours: Part-time, project-based. Expect 5–10 hours per week to start, growing as the series scales.



How to apply:

Send me a link to 2–3 short-form videos you've edited (Reels, Shorts, or TikTok — not long-form). If you don't have short-form samples, don't apply.



In your message, tell me what you'd do differently if a video's hook isn't landing in the first two seconds. I want to hear how you think, not just what tools you use.



Please don't send a template application.

APPLY HERE: 



ABOUT US

We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer footwear brand on Shopify, with over 88,000 reviews and a large paid-social presence. That growth has made us a target: counterfeiters, dropshippers cloning our store, and people running our ads and photos without permission. We are hiring a Brand Protection Specialist to find this activity and shut it down.



THE ROLE

This is hands-on enforcement work, not strategy. You will hunt for infringers across marketplaces, social platforms, and the web, then remove them through the right channels. You report to our team lead and are measured on how much you take down and how fast.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

* Monitor marketplaces, social platforms, and search results for counterfeit listings, cloned stores, and stolen creatives and photos

* File DMCA takedown notices with web hosts, registrars, and platforms

* Work platform IP portals: Meta, TikTok and TikTok Shop, Amazon Brand Registry, eBay VeRO, AliExpress, Google, and Shopify

* Gather evidence (URLs, screenshots, timestamps, side-by-side comparisons) for each case

* Handle rejections and counter-notices, and escalate when a case warrants it

* Send clear weekly reports on what was removed and its impact



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* Proven brand protection, anti-counterfeit, or IP enforcement experience, ideally for a Shopify or DTC brand

* Direct experience filing DMCA notices and using platform IP portals

* A clear grasp of the DMCA process, including counter-notices, and the difference between real infringement and legitimate resale

title: CAD Drafter (AutoDesk Inventor)
description:
Job Summary:

We are hiring a CAD Drafter (AutoDesk Inventor) to produce precise 3D solid models and 2D drawings of bent metal parts from supplied job cards. This role requires a strong grasp of bend geometry and sheet metal fabrication, plus the ability to nest order quantities and lay out loads for shipping. We are looking for a meticulous, technically skilled drafter who works comfortably to defined file and drawing standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Build accurate 3D solid models and 2D drawings of bent metal parts in AutoDesk Inventor from job cards

- Read job card specs including bend radius and angle, chord and arc length, mid-coordinate values, and end tangents

- Export each part as a STEP file and DWG, and create ISO drawings per part

- Nest full order quantities and produce a nested model and DWG for each order

- Create load layout drawings placing parts on an 8-foot-wide trailer at the required length

- Flag any load wider than 8 feet as over-width

- Check model accuracy against mid-coordinate inspection values

- Follow file-naming, drawing, and nesting standards set during onboarding



Mandatory Skills:

- Proven experience with AutoDesk Inventor Professional

- Strong command of bend geometry: radius, angle, chord, arc length, mid-coordinates, and tangents

- Experience producing 3D models and 2D production drawings of metal parts

- Ability to manage STEP, DWG, and ISO drawing files

- Experience with part nesting and load layout drawings

- Familiarity with sheet metal or structural fabrication geometry

- Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

- Strong communication skills



Preferred Skills:

- Background in metal fabrication, manufacturing, or structural engineering

- Experience planning shipping or over-width load layouts

- Familiarity with inspection and dimensional verification workflows

- Ability to handle multiple orders and drawing sets at once



Why Join Us:

This is a hands-on technical role where precision truly counts. You'll join a team that values accuracy and craftsmanship, with clear standards to work from and the chance to grow your responsibilities over time.
